text: The king spoke to his queen before the war.
translation: 战前国王与王后交谈。
note: queen 前面是 his king —— 国王的妻子，不是女王。

text: She met the young queen at the palace gate.
translation: 她在宫门见到了年轻的王后。
note: 王宫里国王的妻子，与 s2 女王的统治职能区分。

text: Every queen must stand beside the king.
translation: 每位王后都必须站在国王身边。
note: beside the king 只可能是妻子，不是女王。

text: The old king loved his queen very much.
translation: 老国王非常爱他的王后。
note: his queen = 王后

text: Her mother became the king's happy queen.
translation: 她母亲成了国王快乐的王后。
note: 王后是「国王的妻子」这一身份。

text: The young queen ruled her country for forty years.
translation: 这位年轻女王统治她的国家四十年。
note: ruled a country 是君主，s1 王后不统治。

text: The whole country came to see the new queen.
translation: 全国人民都来看新女王。
note: 一国之君，与「国王的妻子」不同。

text: People stood up when the queen walked into the room.
translation: 女王走进房间时人们都站了起来。
note: 对君主行礼。

text: The queen of this land is the oldest woman alive.
translation: 这片土地的女王是当地最年长的女性。
note: of a land 表明是君主。

text: Even in war time the queen kept her calm.
translation: 即使在战时，女王仍保持镇定。
note: 女王是国家元首，s1 王后没有这个职能。

text: The people chose to queen their old singer.
translation: 人民选择让那位老歌手当上女王。
note: queen somebody = 立为女王

text: They will queen a new leader next month.
translation: 他们下个月将立一位新领袖为女王。
note: queen + 宾语 = 立为女王

text: The army wanted to queen their young king.
translation: 军队想立他们的年轻国王为女王。
note: queen 后面直接跟宾语是「立为」。

text: It is rare for a country to queen a common man.
translation: 一个国家立平民为女王是很少见的。
note: 立为女王这个动作本身。

text: The old story tells of a fish that became queen.
translation: 这个老故事讲了一条被加冕成女王的鱼。
note: 故事里被加冕；s4 是「以女王身份存在」。

text: A queen bee rules the whole hive for years.
translation: 蜂后在整个蜂群里统治许多年。
note: 固定搭配「蜂后」，是「做女王」这一义。

text: The cat sat there like a queen on her chair.
translation: 那只猫像女王一样坐在椅子上。
note: 像女王一样 —— s3 是「加冕成女王」。

text: She reigns as a queen in that small shop.
translation: 她在那个小店里以女王姿态经营。
note: reign as = 做女王

text: The widow would rather be a queen than a wife.
translation: 那寡妇宁愿做女王也不愿做妻子。
note: 宁愿做女王：身份选择。

text: To queen the land is to rule it well.
translation: 做女王就是要好好统治这片土地。
note: to queen = 做女王
